idea.title: An online clothing store
idea.description: Sell my own clothing designs online.
idea.author: user

questions.text: Where will your customers use it?
questions.why: This shapes almost everything after it, including cost and time. The AI should not pick this for you.

options.label: A website
options.note: Opens in any browser, on phones and computers.
needs: A web address (domain name), renewed yearly
Web hosting to keep the site online

options.label: A phone app
options.note: Installed from the App Store or Google Play.
needs: Apple and Google developer accounts (yearly fees)
App store review before each release

options.label: Both
options.note: Reaches the most people, costs the most.
needs: A web address (domain name), renewed yearly
Web hosting to keep the site online
Apple and Google developer accounts (yearly fees)
Two things to build and keep updated

questions.text: Who will be buying?
questions.default: Everyday shoppers buying one or two items.

options.label: Shops buying in bulk
needs: Bulk price lists and minimum order sizes

options.label: Both
needs: Two price lists: regular and bulk
A way to mark some customers as bulk buyers

questions.text: What should people be able to do?
questions.hint: Pick everything you want. Each one becomes its own part of your plan.
questions.default: Nothing gets planned until you pick at least one.

suggestions.text: A place for you to add clothes and see orders
suggestions.why: Almost every store needs this. The AI flags it because it was not on your list.

browse.title: Browse my clothes
browse.description: How people look through what you sell
browse.author: user

questions.text: How should people find things?
questions.default: One list of everything, newest first.

options.label: By category
options.note: Dresses, shirts, trousers and so on.
needs: Your list of categories

options.label: Filter by colour
needs: Each item tagged with its colours

questions.text: How much should people see of each item?
questions.default: A few photos from different angles.

options.label: One photo
needs: One good photo per item

options.label: A few photos from different angles
needs: Three to five photos per item

options.label: Photos and a short video
needs: A short video per item
Video hosting (pages load slower on weak connections)

questions.text: What happens when a size sells out?
questions.why: This is a business choice about your stock, not a technical one.

options.label: Let people ask to be told when it is back
needs: Emails or messages to say it is back

options.label: Let people pre-order it
needs: Taking payment now and delivering later
A clear waiting time for each pre-order

suggestions.why: Gives returning shoppers a reason to look again.
needs: A date on each item for when it was added

suggestions.why: Clothing stores get fewer returns when sizes are explained.

sizeguide.title: Size guide
sizeguide.description: Helping people pick the right size
sizeguide.author: ai

questions.text: What sizes do you use?
questions.default: Letter sizes: S, M, L, XL.

options.label: My own measurements
needs: A measurement chart for each type of item

questions.text: How should the guide help?

options.label: Ask their height and fit, then suggest a size
needs: Your rules for which size suits whom

questions.text: How will you get paid?
questions.why: Each option changes your costs, your risk and who does the checking. Only you can weigh that.

options.label: Card payments online
needs: A payment provider account (it takes a small fee per sale)

options.label: Bank transfer
needs: Someone to check each transfer by hand before shipping

options.label: Pay on delivery
needs: Riders who can collect payment
A plan for deliveries that get refused

questions.text: Where will you deliver?
questions.why: Your delivery area decides prices, partners and paperwork.

options.label: Across the country
needs: A courier that covers the whole country

options.label: Other countries too
needs: An international courier
Customs forms for each parcel
Prices in more than one currency

questions.text: If a payment fails, what should the customer see?
questions.why: The AI could guess, but a wrong guess loses sales or annoys customers.

options.label: Try again, with the cart kept
Keep the cart and remind them later
needs: Reminder emails or messages

suggestions.why: Useful for launches, sales and working with influencers.

suggestions.text: Send a receipt after every order
suggestions.why: Customers expect proof of what they bought.
needs: An email service for receipts

questions.text: Describe your delivery fee in your own words.
questions.why: Only you know your prices. Write it the way you would explain it to a customer.

questions.text: Does the free-delivery amount count before or after discounts?
questions.why: Your description did not say, and each answer changes what customers pay.

options.label: My fee has no free-delivery amount

questions.text: Who does the delivering?

options.label: A courier company
needs: An account with a courier company

options.label: Customers pick up
needs: A pickup address and opening hours

questions.text: What kinds of discount?
Can someone use more than one code at once?
questions.why: Combined codes can wipe out your profit. This is your call.

questions.text: Can people buy without making an account?
questions.why: Forcing sign-up gets you more contacts but loses some buyers. Only you can make that trade.

options.label: No, they must sign up first

questions.text: How should people sign in?
questions.default: Email with a one-time code, so nobody needs a password.

options.label: Email and password
needs: A way to reset forgotten passwords

options.label: Google or Apple sign-in
needs: Setup with Google and Apple

questions.text: If someone asks you to delete their data, what do you keep?
questions.why: This depends on the rules where you operate and on your records. Check with someone qualified.

options.label: Keep order records, delete the rest
needs: A note of which records you keep, and why

questions.text: How should they hear about updates?

options.label: Email
needs: An email service

options.label: Text message
needs: A text message service (costs per message)

options.label: WhatsApp
needs: A WhatsApp Business account

questions.text: Can they cancel after paying?
questions.why: Cancellation rules affect refunds and your stock.

options.label: Yes, within a set time
needs: Your cancellation time limit

questions.text: Do you accept returns?
questions.why: Your return policy is a promise to customers. It has to come from you.

options.label: Returns with a refund
needs: A refund process with your payment provider
A written return policy

questions.text: Should saving favourites need an account?
questions.default: Saved on their device, no account needed.

options.label: No, save them on their device
options.note: They lose them if they switch phones.

suggestions.text: Tell people when a favourite goes on sale
suggestions.why: Brings shoppers back at the right moment.
needs: Emails or messages for sale alerts

questions.text: Who can leave a review?
questions.why: Open reviews bring more feedback, but also fake ones.

options.label: Only people who bought the item

questions.text: Do you check reviews before they appear?
questions.why: This is about your brand and your time.

options.label: Yes, I approve each one
needs: Time set aside to approve reviews

options.label: No, but I can remove them later

suggestions.why: Shoppers trust real photos of how clothes fit.
needs: Storage for customer photos

questions.text: Who will manage the store?

options.label: Me and staff
needs: Staff logins that only see what they need

questions.text: How will you add new clothes?
questions.default: One at a time, with a simple form.

options.label: Upload a spreadsheet
needs: A spreadsheet template to fill in
